steps.title: Open ADD on the job
steps.body: From the job, click + ADD at the bottom of the screen. Approvals can go out before the job (inspection photos, pricing, schedule), during (upsell sign-offs), or after (post-job photos, satisfaction agreements).

steps.title: Choose Approval
steps.body: Pick Approval. Every Approval automatically carries the job details, line items, pricing and totals — the customer signs off on all of it.

steps.title: Set the message and expiration
steps.body: Add an optional Title, tweak the customer-facing Comment, and set Expires On.
steps.note: Defaults live in Preferences > Approval — including auto-voiding after a set time and auto-resending a pending approval on a schedule.

steps.title: Attach documents
steps.body: Check the Documents to include — liability waivers, service agreements, T&Cs. These are one of three things a customer can sign off on, alongside your schedule and inspection photos.
steps.note: Upload your standard documents once in Preferences > Job > Documents and they'll be available on every job. Inspection photos attach from the job's Inspections tab.

steps.title: Open the add-ons
steps.body: Scroll to the bottom and click Select add-ons — suggested extras the customer can accept right inside the Approval.

steps.title: Pick the upsells
steps.body: Choose the add-on service(s) — here a Windshield Coating. The customer just flips a toggle to accept while they review.

steps.title: Send it
steps.body: Pick SMS or Email and hit SEND. The toggle below hides per-item quantities and unit prices if you'd rather show one number.

steps.title: What your customer sees
steps.body: The full job, your documents, and the add-on toggle. Anything they toggle on moves up into the line items and gets added to the total. When they click Approve, a signature box appears — with your T&Cs linked right in it.

steps.title: Let them self-schedule
steps.body: Want the calendar to appear after they approve? Go to Preferences > Calendar > External and check Approvals under Online Booking. Customer approves, picks a day and time, then signs — booked and signed in one pass.

steps.title: Capture a payment method
steps.body: In Preferences > Approval, toggle on Collect a customer's payment method when approving. When they sign off, they're prompted to put a card on file.
steps.note: This never charges the customer — it only asks for a card if there isn't one on file already. This screen also holds the auto-void and auto-resend settings.

steps.title: A documented green light
steps.body: The Approval sits as Pending until your customer acts. When they approve and sign, it's time-stamped and attached to the job — and if they toggled on add-ons, an alert appears on the job with Apply buttons so you decide what makes it onto the invoice.
